question.question: In triangle ABC, if side AB = 14 cm, side BC = 20 cm, and angle C = 72°, find angle A using the cosine formula. Show your working.
question.referenceAnswer: Using the cosine formula, \(\cos A = \frac{20^2 + 20.566^2 - 14^2}{2 \times 20 \times 20.566}\) \(\approx \frac{400 + 423.5 - 196}{822.6}\) \(\approx \frac{627.5}{822.6}\) \(\approx 0.763\), so \(A \approx 40.3^\circ\).
question.evidence: By the cosine formula, \(\cos A = \frac{b^2 + c^2 - a^2}{2bc}\) \(= \frac{20^2 + 20.566^2 - 14^2}{2 \times 20 \times 20.566}\) \(A = 40.3^\circ\) \(\text{cor. to 3 sig. fig.}\)
